# Public knowledge retrieval development corpus

This small corpus is a public, deliberately synthetic development/adversarial
fixture. It is safe to inspect while implementing retrieval. It is not a
sealed holdout and must never be cited as release qualification evidence.

The fixture exercises exact source locators, source-bound semantic kinds,
controlled Chinese/English terminology, no-answer behavior, applicability
conflicts, explicit rejection, citations, and stale source versions. The
accepted knowledge text intentionally paraphrases its evidence so the product
must bind structured kinds to the exact source passage rather than merely
matching a generated summary.
